glass_caravan.title: A Caravan on the Flats
glass_caravan.description: A high-wheeled cart waits in the shade of a glass outcrop. The trader spreads a few goods across the tailgate.

shard_shrine.title: The Shard Shrine
shard_shrine.description: A cairn of dark stones with a splinter of glass at its crown. The air around it is cool and still.
